search.fusion: joint (INPROCESS fused blocks), Cedar fusion rules
search.backend: joint (INPROCESS / SMP / RAY per block, resource-feasible)
search.stage_width: NOT searched; every parallel stage fixed at width 1 (_dp_candidate_parallelisms -> (1,))
search.W: searched by the W-conditioned DP; candidates = 1..min(cap, local_budget//(1+reserve), ray_budget); 64 CPU per host; infeasible slices skipped
search.cache: Cedar cache placement rules, joint when the feature has a cache pipe
search.compute_model: k_(operator, representation_class) * elements + b_(operator, representation_class); elements = C*H*W (image), W*H*bands (PIL), len (text)
search.objective: DpObjectiveCost (score/W = serial compute/W + byte service), boundary transition cost added per transition
search.profile_schema: physical_model.compute_model schema_version=1 + physical_model.operator_affine (legacy byte model kept for baselines)
